purpose: Add causal spread, midpoint, quote-age and displayed-size features to simultaneous cross-sectional research.

universe_contract.requested_rows: every symbol-date-bar_idx row already present in v14309_v14408_events.parquet
universe_contract.cross_sectional_semantics: all requested symbols at one decision timestamp are one joint research cross-section

time_contract.quote_timestamp_rule: strictly less than completed five-minute decision cutoff

acquisition_contract.missingness: explicit missing row; never forward-fill beyond 120 seconds
acquisition_contract.raw_tick_retention_reason: The entitlement probe returned 25,938 SIP quote updates for only two liquid symbols in five minutes; full raw history is not economical.
acquisition_contract.immutable_output: zstd parquet plus SHA-256 manifest per month, bar index and symbol batch
acquisition_contract.resume: existing complete hash-valid shards are reused; partial shards fail closed
